items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Who else was in the Belgian, your group? ... And a good vibraphone player. He died. Uh… [Savie Larlamans?].

ctx.x: Who else was in the Belgian, your group? Bobby Jasper, yourself.

And a good vibraphone player. He died. Uh… [Savie Larlamans?]. And he was really Hampton, a little more articulate harmonically. But he was a showman and a combination Fats Waller and Lionel Hampton, you know.
